newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER UNDER PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER UNDER PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Thursday's active interbank session weaker against hard units, pressured by high importer demand for foreign currency.

"The market got short some time during the day and the Zimbabwe dollar went down. The RBZ (central Reserve Bank) had to come in at the 10.8550 level to support the unit. But it looks like the pressure is still on and the dollar might continue falling tomorrow," a dealer commented.
The local unit finished the day at 10.8550/8700 against the U.S. dollar from 10.8250/8400 overnight and also lost against pound sterling to 18.3600/3800 from 18.2980/3369.
It was at 6.8900/9100 from 6.8879/8996 against the mark and at 2.3300/3500 versus the rand, down from 2.3153/3210 at Wednesday's close.
